heroHeadline: Syria Carries Out First Cabinet Reshuffle Since Assad's Ouster
heroSubtitle: Syria's transitional government announced its first cabinet reshuffle since the fall of Bashar al-Assad (May 9), marking a consolidation milestone for the Ahmed al-Sharaa administration. Earlier, Syria's security services dismantled a Hezbollah-linked cell planning to assassinate senior transitional officials (May 5), while Israel conducted over 20 airstrikes across Syrian territory on May 2.
